long_biography.plain_text:
Sean Lawley established Lawley Automotive Group in Sierra Vista, Arizona, in 1995. Over nearly three decades, he developed it from a local dealership platform into a multi-franchise automotive retailer serving communities in Arizona and New Mexico. The group combined new- and used-vehicle sales with servicing and related dealership operations.

Lawley first sold his Silver City dealerships to another regional operator. He later agreed to sell the Sierra Vista network to Ed Morse Automotive Group, choosing a buyer that would retain the dealership employees. The transaction concluded his ownership of the operating group and accelerated his retirement plans, leaving his principal public business legacy in regional automotive retail.
